run_infer_video_d2: run the infer_video_d2 module to perform end-to-end human pose and bbox inference on a video file using Detectron2
parse_args_infer_video_d2: parse command-line arguments for the infer_video_d2 script including cfg, output-dir, image-ext, and input video or folder
get_resolution_video: get the width and height resolution of a video file using ffprobe
read_video_frames: read a video file frame-by-frame as numpy arrays using ffmpeg image2pipe
main_infer_video_d2: run the main inference pipeline that processes videos with Detectron2 and saves keypoints and bounding boxes as npz files
